milestone.title: raul Autopilot lane — auto-refresh policy + idle poller

intent.outcome: The Autopilot lane polls `mp autopilot session show <id>` and `mp autopilot-control status` every `autopilot.refresh_secs` seconds (default 2) when the lane is focused and the raul TUI is not in input mode; manual `p` toggles the poll on/off; `r` forces an immediate refresh. The poll behavior respects per-session override of `refresh_secs` set by the D2 override panel.

problem.description: D3 ships with manual refresh only. For long drives (multi-hour milestones), users need at-a-glance freshness without spamming `r`. The poll must not interfere with input mode, must not poll when the lane isn't visible, and must respect per-session overrides. F3's hygiene sweep is downstream; this milestone is the last piece of the lane UX.

in_scope: Idle poller in `crates/raul/src/tui/poll.rs` (or extend the existing D3 module): a per-app poller with a configurable interval (default 2s, configurable via `session.json.config_overrides.refresh_secs`).
Polling pauses when: (a) the Autopilot lane is not the active lane, (b) raul is in any input mode, (c) explicit pause (`p` toggles a `poll_paused` flag).
Manual refresh hook (`r`): the existing D3 `r` handler now also resets the poll timer so a forced refresh doesn't fire again immediately.
Lifecycle: poll starts when a session becomes active; stops when the session enters a terminal state (lifecycle=shipped or escalated).
out_of_scope: Steering or pause/cancel controls — separate track.
Auto-refresh of any other raul lane — Autopilot only.

acceptance_criteria.description: The poller fires `mp autopilot session show` + `mp autopilot-control status` once per `refresh_secs`; verified by a fake clock test that advances fake time and counts calls.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — implementation produces the documented behavior; verifier allows manual ACs in draft state. Implementation-phase replacement of this verification with a per-AC cargo nextest command happens when the corresponding test lands.

acceptance_criteria.description: Polling pauses when the Autopilot lane is not the active lane and resumes when it becomes active.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — implementation produces the documented behavior; verifier allows manual ACs in draft state. Implementation-phase replacement of this verification with a per-AC cargo nextest command happens when the corresponding test lands.

acceptance_criteria.description: Manual `r` triggers an immediate refresh; the poll timer is reset so it does not fire again immediately. Manual `p` toggles the poll on/off; the toggle state is visible in the lane footer.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — implementation produces the documented behavior; verifier allows manual ACs in draft state. Implementation-phase replacement of this verification with a per-AC cargo nextest command happens when the corresponding test lands.

acceptance_criteria.description: Per-session `refresh_secs` override (set via D2's override panel) is honored; the polish default (2s) applies when no override.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — implementation produces the documented behavior; verifier allows manual ACs in draft state. Implementation-phase replacement of this verification with a per-AC cargo nextest command happens when the corresponding test lands.

acceptance_criteria.description: State-change detection: the poller maintains a snapshot of session.json.roles.<role>.state keyed by (session_id, role). On each tick it reads the latest session.json and emits a `StateChanged(role, old_state, new_state, evidence_refs)` event for each role whose state changed.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — implementation produces the documented behavior; when the matching test fixture exists, this verification is replaced with a per-AC `cargo nextest run -p <crate> --test <name> --no-fail-fast` command.

acceptance_criteria.description: TUI relay: when a state-change event fires, the poller dispatches a fixed-format `TUI relay: <role> state <old> → <new>; evidence: <refs>` message to the orchestrator pane via `herdr agent prompt <orch-pane-id> "..."`. The orchestrator's verifier (C2) re-reads session.json and applies the standard cross-check before acting.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — implementation produces the documented behavior; when the matching test fixture exists, this verification is replaced with a per-AC `cargo nextest run -p <crate> --test <name> --no-fail-fast` command.

acceptance_criteria.description: Liveness pulse probes: on a separate cadence (`autopilot.pulse_secs`, default 60s), the poller sends `herdr agent prompt <lane-pane-id> "pulse"` to any lane whose state is Working/Reviewing. If no state change is observed within the pulse window, escalate per C2.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — implementation produces the documented behavior; when the matching test fixture exists, this verification is replaced with a per-AC `cargo nextest run -p <crate> --test <name> --no-fail-fast` command.

design_decisions.choice: Use a single idle-poller task with a tick counter, gated by lane-active + input-mode + paused flags. Polling is fire-and-forget (no back-pressure).
design_decisions.rationale: Matches raul's existing redraw pipeline (M190 frame gate); no new event loop.

design_decisions.choice: Override chain for refresh_secs: session.json `config_overrides.refresh_secs` > config.json `autopilot.refresh_secs` > built-in default (2).
design_decisions.rationale: Reuses the resolution-chain logic from B1; the override panel updates the session.json value.
